key_themes: Broadcom earnings disappoint on AI chip outlook, triggering $1T semiconductor sector sell-off
Meta considers multi-billion-dollar secondary stock offering to fund AI capex, weighing on mega-cap tech
Quantinuum Nasdaq IPO debut concentrates quantum capital, pressuring Rigetti, D-Wave, and IonQ

Dropped ~6% as Broadcom earnings disappointment rattled AI chip trade; market cap fell below $5 trillion threshold in sympathy sell-off across semiconductor sector
Fell ~7% as Broadcom's weak AI chip outlook spread across the semiconductor sector, dragging down the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index more than 8% on the day
Dropped ~17% over two sessions following Broadcom earnings; memory and chip stocks broadly impacted as investors rotated out of AI-related semiconductor names that had surged sharply year-to-date

Slumped ~12% alongside sector peers Rigetti and IonQ as Quantinuum's $1.68B Nasdaq IPO concentrated quantum computing capital into the new name, triggering broad sell-off in existing pure-play quantum stocks
